cards.title: Embrace 'Slow September' for Better Family Life
cards.body: September pressure to optimize can lead to burnout. Instead, slow down by chatting with strangers and letting kids experience boredom. These simple shifts help families reap real benefits.

cards.title: I Didn't Know I Was Pregnant Until Birth
cards.body: A 19-year-old had no morning sickness, cravings, or tiredness throughout her pregnancy. She discovered she was pregnant only when giving birth. Her family initially didn't believe the unexpected arrival.

cards.title: Taking Toddlers to Music Festivals Works
cards.body: Families with young children can thrive at music festivals despite skeptics' claims. The author shares how bringing twins added magic to events. Children don't spoil the experience—they enhance it.

cards.title: Teaching Children to Use AI Safely
cards.body: Parents can help children navigate AI technology with clear family rules. Understanding AI's benefits and risks prepares kids for today's digital world. Six practical strategies make AI safety manageable.

cards.title: 6 Signs of Temperament-Driven Sleep Issues
cards.body: Children's fragmented sleep often reflects natural temperament traits, not poor parenting. Specific behavioral and sleep signals reveal what's driving struggles. Working with your child's wiring leads to better rest.

cards.title: The Hidden Grief of Adoptee Birthdays
cards.body: Adoptees often experience grief and identity questions around birthdays. Acknowledging this complex emotion helps them feel truly seen and supported. Birthdays carry deeper meaning for adopted children.

cards.title: Russell Howard's Baby Son Dies After Birth
cards.body: The comedian announced his son Felix died shortly after birth earlier this year. His wife Cerys had just given birth when the tragedy occurred. Howard expressed devastation over the unexpected loss.
